common: FIRST read docs/redesign/verification/r15/tooling/COMMON.md, then docs/redesign/verification/r15/tooling/PROMPT_census.md's PACK section (for context on the pack), then docs/redesign/verification/r15/tooling/PROMPT_data_s2.md in full (the diff and refute stages are spec'd there; PROMPT_refute.md too for the refute stage). Continue from any existing output file; never restart.

stages.label: diff
stages.prompt: Slot "{{id}}" (symbol "{{symbol}}"). Pack: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/packs/{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json. Collected: docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json. Run the DIFF stage of PROMPT_data_s2.md: diff all fields incl. the mandatory subtle tier (shareholding/promoter/FII/DII, declared vs paid dividends, 52w high+low, every as-of date). Write docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/diffs/{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json and docs/redesign/verification/r15/census/raw/data-{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json (raw_id prefix DAT-{{id}}, area "data", subsystem "{{id}}_{{symbol}}"; empty array [] if zero qualifying mismatches). Return the RESULT object with count = raw findings written.

stages.label: refute
stages.prompt: Refute the diff findings for slot "{{id}}" (symbol "{{symbol}}"). Raw file: docs/redesign/verification/r15/census/raw/data-{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json ({{count}} findings per the diff stage's result). Output: docs/redesign/verification/r15/census/refute/data-{{id}}_{{symbol}}.json. Follow PROMPT_refute.md exactly (PROMPT_data_s2.md's REFUTE section states the raw/output path substitution and that you may re-fetch one pack source via curl). If the raw file is [], confirm and write [] as your verdict file. Return the RESULT object.
